project.description: The land in tiles: squares of the map, each halved into four at the next level down, its points so many to a side; what lies at each point of a tile sampled from the land, worked out when asked for and kept only while wanted; and which tiles are wanted around a spot, finer near it and coarser further off, no tile beside one more than a level finer or coarser, and which of each tile's edges meet a coarser one. Plain Java, knowing no engine: whatever draws the land, or stands on it, asks the same tiles of the same land.
